display_name: FAA Airport and Aeronautical Facility Context
coverage: Mississippi statewide airport and aeronautical facility points
known_limitations: Airport and aeronautical facility points provide screening context and do not establish airspace clearance, obstruction review outcomes, or project approval.
Facility status, type, and operational details require reviewer confirmation against current FAA/local aviation sources before external reporting.
Materialization clips facility points to the project analysis bounds used by the current local materializer; broader aviation coordination context may require reviewer judgment.
notes: Manually downloaded airport shapefile bundle. Raw files are preserved under raw/ and remain local/ignored.
